credits.title: Avaraachan & Sons
credits.overview: Follows Avarachan, his children and the various family and social relationships that shape their lives.

credits.title: It's a Medical Miracle
credits.overview: A young man declared brain-dead suddenly awakens with the ability to hear everything. Seeking the nurse whose voice saved him, he's drawn into a dark game of masks, memories, and revenge where every sound may be a clue or a trap.

credits.title: Ayalvaashi
credits.overview: A petty misunderstanding changes Thajudheen and Benny's relationship from friends to foes. Thajudheen goes above and beyond to prove his innocence but ends up making things worse for his loved ones.
